prices.source: router.huggingface.co/v1/models (moonshotai/Kimi-K3 provider baseten: $3.00 input, $15.00 output per million tokens)

data_retention_note: Hugging Face forwards each request to the pinned third-party provider (Baseten), whose own data-retention policy applies. Lab camera images and depth data sent with every call leave this machine.
model_verified: 2026-10-02: router.huggingface.co/v1/models lists moonshotai/Kimi-K3 (Kimi K3 License, not OSI) as natively multimodal (image and video input) on together (supports_structured_output false), fireworks, baseten (supports_structured_output true, ~74 tok/s), deepinfra and featherless. The model card documents thinking always on (returned as reasoning_content), reasoning_effort low / high / max (default max) and single-step sampling temperature 1.0 / top_p 0.95. Vision and reasoning both verified.
notes: MLLM-01 per 15-CONTEXT.md D-13/D-15/D-20/D-21/D-23. Pinned to baseten, the fastest provider with structured output; unpinned :fastest routing can land on a provider without it (together has none; research C2, Pitfall 2). Kimi-K3 is not cheap: $3 input / $15 output per million tokens (Opus-class pricing, roughly $0.35 per call at ~20K output tokens; research C1), so Phase 16 should run the Qwen and DeepSeek variants first and fund HF credits before any Kimi run. Thinking is always on for this model; effort max is its default and highest level (research C11). No context_window is set because the router listing gives none for this provider. No replacement from the D-23 shortlist (google/gemma-4-31B-it, zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash) was needed: all three HF models passed the vision and reasoning checks. The first live smoke per variant (Plan 15-10) must confirm routing to the pinned provider, reasoning tokens and reasoning text under json_schema mode (assumptions A3/A4) and image acceptance (A6; set image_format to jpeg if the provider rejects the request size). If the pinned provider rejects json_schema, a human sets structured_mode to json_object (schema in the system prompt, client-side validation); there is no automatic fallback. api_key_env names the environment variable holding a fine-grained HF token with Inference Providers permission; never put the token itself in this file.
